name: Netoraren'ai ~Ai Suru Kanojo ga Musunda Midara na Keiyaku~
original_name: ネトラレンアイ ～愛する彼女が結んだ淫らな契約～
source:
* "Because she was a beautiful flower... the despair and humility of her soiling, the tears, the whimpers of loss, the cries of agony, the abandonment... are all the more exquisite..."

The scheme of a piece of human garbage! The obscene downward spiral of a lover!
She trusted a man and he broke her into a four-legged wretch in this forbidden cuckold story!

Yuki Nasukawa has gorgeous hair, speaks in gentle whispers, with perfect breasts
and a purity she vowed to give only to you---and it was all torn away!
The cucking bastard took every hole, staining her inside and out with his seed!
There's nothing virginal left about her!! and certainly nothing left for you...

* Welcome to a world of graceless & merciless & unstoppable NTR

To protect her boyfriend's reputation she inevitably surrendered her own.

At school, at home, on the town, in the midnight park, at a love hotel.
Regardless of place or time, her life is a parade of flagrant shame & humiliation & lust!

Sex! sex! sex! without a breather nonstop,
wanton seduction takes an innocent girlfriend
on a one-way path over the precipice of desire with no way back!
Unseemly desire supplants the love that once was!
